evidence_kind: numerical known-deviation regression, not hardware parity
rationale: The original ws1-voice acceptance limits remain unchanged. These separate ceilings prevent the already-failing high-cutoff cells from silently worsening. They are NOT relaxed acceptance limits. Over-limit baseline observations were known before these ceilings were chosen; direct-DUT and refinement limits were chosen before running the new fixtures.

configurations: HP at max(60,fc/4) into LP at fc
ig00156_top_octave_regressions.ceiling_pair_meaning: [core, full-band], complex error divided by continuous response peak; same bands as ws1-voice. Cells already passing keep their original acceptance limits; failing cells receive rounded roughly 5 percent regression headroom.
ig00156_top_octave_regressions.direct_fixture: Actual realtime stage/cascade, amplitude 1e-5, coherent 8192-sample lock-in after 0.35 seconds settling. Measure requested fc and each analytic fixture's worst full-band frequency rounded to a coherent bin. Compare to the independent nodal system under the documented trapezoidal map. Also check measured continuous-truth error against the matching full-band regression ceiling.
ig00156_top_octave_regressions.refinement_fixture: Same physical 20 Hz..min(20 kHz, base fs/5) band at base/2x/4x rates, bases 88.2 and 96 kHz, cutoffs 4 and 12 kHz, full Q/config grid. Aggregate maximum complex error must shrink by at least 65 percent per doubling. This is not a CPU or runtime-quality-policy qualification.
